title: Military officer briefs Gaetz on hybrid breeding programs

tellings.quote: >> He did. He absolutely did. He said that there was a someone a military brass person. I he didn't describe their rank or anything, but that came into his office and told them about about hybrids.

related.note: Both are about someone coming into Matt Gaetz's office to tell him about a hidden program. This telling says the visitor described psionic human cargo; the story says hybrid breeding.

plain: A man named Eric Burles says that a US congressman, Matt Gaetz, told him about a visit to his office in Washington in the 2020s. According to Burles, Gaetz said a senior military officer, whose rank was not given, came in and told him about hybrids, meaning programmes said to breed beings that are part human and part something else. If true, it would mean members of Congress are being briefed on such programmes in private.
